en: A unit of weight equal to 1,000 grams.
ex: I bought two kilograms of apples at the market.
我在市場買了兩公斤蘋果。

en: Nervous and embarrassed about meeting or talking to other people.
ex: The shy girl hid behind her mother.
那個害羞的女孩躲在媽媽背後。

en: The woman that a man is married to.
ex: His wife works as a nurse in a hospital.
他的妻子在醫院當護理師。

en: A dry fruit with a hard shell that grows on trees; or a small metal piece that screws onto a bolt.
ex: The squirrel found a nut and ate it.
松鼠找到一顆堅果並把它吃掉。

en: A serious disagreement or fight between people or groups; or to be different or opposite.
ex: The two countries have been in conflict for years.
這兩個國家已經衝突了多年。

en: A strong hard metal made from iron and carbon, used to make buildings, tools and machines.
ex: The bridge is made of steel and is very strong.
這座橋是鋼製的，非常堅固。

en: The ability to do something difficult or dangerous without showing fear.
ex: It takes courage to tell the truth.
說實話需要勇氣。

en: On the far side of something; or later than; or more than.
ex: There is a small village beyond the mountains.
山的另一邊有一座小村莊。

en: To be present at an event, meeting or place such as a school; or to pay attention.
ex: All students must attend the meeting on Friday.
所有學生都必須參加星期五的會議。

en: A large black and white animal from China that eats bamboo.
ex: The panda at the zoo eats bamboo all day.
動物園裡的熊貓整天都在吃竹子。

en: A magazine or book with stories told in pictures; or funny and amusing; or someone who makes people laugh.
ex: He loves reading comic books after school.
他放學後喜歡看漫畫書。

en: The direction where the sun goes down; or the part of a place in that direction.
ex: The sun sets in the west.
太陽從西邊落下。

en: To agree that something is true, often unwillingly; or to let someone enter a place.
ex: He admitted that he had broken the window.
他承認窗戶是他打破的。

en: To give food and drink to someone at a meal; or to work for a person or organization; or to be useful.
ex: The waiter served us soup and bread.
服務生給我們上了湯和麵包。

en: A particular way of doing something; or a system or order.
ex: This is a quick method for learning new words.
這是學習新單字的快速方法。

en: A person who is older than you; or older in age or rank; or a respected older person.
ex: My elder sister is a teacher in Taipei.
我姊姊在台北當老師。

en: A substance you use with water to wash your skin or clothes.
ex: Wash your hands with soap and water.
用肥皂和水洗手。

en: Twice as much or as many; or having two parts; or to become twice as big.
ex: The price of food has doubled in five years.
食物價格在五年內翻了一倍。

en: A place where alcohol is served; or a long, straight piece of something hard; or to stop someone from doing something.
ex: She bought a chocolate bar at the store.
她在商店買了一條巧克力棒。

en: To keep doing something without stopping; or to start again after a pause.
ex: After a short rest, we continued our journey.
稍微休息後，我們繼續旅程。

en: To move smoothly over a surface; or a playground structure children slide down; or an image shown by a projector.
ex: The children took turns going down the slide.
孩子們輪流玩溜滑梯。

en: A long, thin string of food made from flour and water, eaten in soup or with sauce.
ex: We had a bowl of noodles for lunch.
我們午餐吃了一碗麵。

en: A large piece of cloth fixed to a boat that catches the wind; or to travel by boat.
ex: The boat sailed across the lake at sunrise.
小船在日出時橫渡湖面。

en: A single unit of language with a particular meaning; or a promise; or a message.
ex: I don't know the meaning of this word.
我不知道這個字的意思。

en: The last part of something such as a story or film; or the way something ends.
ex: The movie has a very happy ending.
這部電影有個非常圓滿的結局。

en: Freedom from the control of another country or person; or the ability to take care of yourself.
ex: The country gained its independence in 1960.
這個國家在1960年獲得獨立。

en: A thing that you can see and touch but is not alive; or the aim of something; or to say that you do not like something.
ex: There is a strange object floating in the water.
有個奇怪的物體漂浮在水中。

en: The act of telling people who someone is; or the first part of a book or speech; or the first use of something new.
ex: She made a short introduction before the speech.
她在演講前做了簡短的介紹。

en: An empty space in a surface or object; or a deep opening in the ground; or a fault in something.
ex: There is a hole in my sock.
我的襪子破了一個洞。

en: The hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks.
ex: Santa Claus has a long white beard.
聖誕老人有一把長長的白鬍子。

en: For each; or according to; or by means of.
ex: The ticket costs ten dollars per person.
門票每人十美元。

en: Relating to most or all people or things; not specific; or a high-ranking officer in the army.
ex: In general, I get up at seven o'clock.
一般來說，我七點起床。

en: Right or appropriate for a particular person, purpose or situation.
ex: This film is not suitable for young children.
這部電影不適合年幼的孩子。

en: A daily record of what you have done; or a magazine or newspaper about a particular subject.
ex: She writes in her journal every night before bed.
她每晚睡前都寫日記。

en: To feel anxious about something; or a problem that makes you anxious.
ex: Don't worry; everything will be fine.
別擔心，一切都會沒事的。

en: A secret word or group of letters or numbers that you must enter to get into a computer or place.
ex: Please enter your password to log in.
請輸入你的密碼登入。

en: The land next to the sea; or to move easily without using much effort.
ex: They live in a small house on the coast.
他們住在海岸邊的一間小房子裡。

en: A system that connects computers around the world so that people can send messages and find information.
ex: You can find a lot of information on the internet.
你可以在網路上找到很多資訊。

en: To give out or reflect bright light; or to be very good at something; or the brightness of a surface.
ex: The sun was shining brightly in the clear sky.
太陽在晴朗的天空中明亮地照耀。

en: To decide that a planned event will not happen; or to stop an order or arrangement.
ex: The match was canceled because of the rain.
比賽因下雨而取消。
